title: 4D Point Splatting for mmWave Radar Micro-Doppler Differentiable Rendering
abstract: arXiv:2611.08342v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Millimeter-wave radar resolves the micrometer displacements of a moving body as micro-Doppler, enabling gait, gesture, activity, pose and vital-sign sensing. Each task relies on a downstream model trained on real data, yet radar datasets lag orders of magnitude behind vision and language. Brute-force collection will not close that gap, and existing synthesis methods (forward-only simulators, learned generators and static-scene inverse renderers) cannot fit a real capture of a moving body, leaving a sim2real gap. We present 4D Point Splatting (4DPS), a physics-based differentiable renderer that fits an explicit moving scene to a real capture. Using the synchronized camera to initialize the room and body, we represent the scene as oriented points carrying material, normal and velocity, and splat each point into range and Doppler bins. translated_title: 面向毫米波雷达微多普勒可微渲染的四维点溅射（4D Point Splatting）
translated_abstract: 毫米波雷达能够将运动物体的微米级位移解析为微多普勒信号，从而实现步态、手势、活动、姿态及生命体征感知。每个任务都依赖于在真实数据上训练的下游模型，然而雷达数据集的规模比视觉和语言领域落后了数个数量级。单纯依靠大规模采集无法弥补这一差距，而现有的合成方法（仅前向的模拟器、学习型生成器以及静态场景逆渲染器）都无法拟合真实采集的运动人体数据，导致存在仿真到现实的鸿沟（sim2real gap）。我们提出了四维点溅射（4DPS），这是一种基于物理的可微渲染器，能够将显式的运动场景拟合到真实采集数据上。利用同步相机对房间和人体进行初始化，我们将场景表示为携带材质、法线和速度信息的定向点，并将每个点溅射到距离和多普勒频谱单元中。我们的输出是真实雷达所记录的原始复数回波，因此我们在其上应用与真实雷达相同的信号处理流程（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了4D点溅射（4DPS），一种基于物理的可微渲染器，通过将携带材质、法线和速度信息的定向点溅射到距离-多普勒域，将显式运动场景拟合到真实毫米波雷达微多普勒采集数据上，输出原始复数回波以缩小雷达感知的sim2real差距并缓解雷达数据稀缺问题。
en_tdlr: We present 4D Point Splatting (4DPS), a physics-based differentiable renderer that fits an explicit moving scene—represented as oriented points carrying material, normal and velocity—splat into range and Doppler bins to real mmWave radar micro-Doppler captures, outputting raw complex returns to bridge the sim2real gap and alleviate radar data scarcity.
